description: Schema-level assertions for P079 GraphQL SDL parity (api-contract-r4-001, api-contract-r4-002). Validates that the output_contract_repair readback surface uses snake_case field names in MCP/run-report and camelCase in GraphQL SDL.
note: AgentExecution.outputContractRepair GraphQL field is implemented in graphql-server/src/types/stage.rs as Json<serde_json::Value> (dynamic JSON scalar), not as the typed OutputContractRepairEvidence SDL surface specified in graphql_sdl_appendix. MCP and run-report snake_case readback is implemented. Full SDL parity (typed GraphQL object with named enum fields per api-contract-r4-001/r4-002) is deferred until the runtime lane is wired. When typed SDL is added the 'status' must change to 'implemented'.
